rmt-2012-team-07.title: Two cards determine the line
rmt-2012-team-07.body:
There are $3^4=81$ cards. Given two cards, each coordinate of the third is forced (equal to theirs if they agree, the remaining value if they differ). If the two cards are distinct this gives a line of three distinct cards, and each such line arises from $\binom32=3$ pairs: $\frac13\binom{81}2=27\cdot40=1080$ lines. In addition, a card repeated three times is a line (all coordinates are all the same), giving $81$ more. Total: $1080+81=1161$.

**Answer: 1161**
